objective: Replace Area mode's dead static sourceRect crop with an intelligent, time-varying crop: capture the full display, keep the user's selected rectangle as the default tight content framing, and smoothly expand the crop to reveal browser chrome while the user clicks or types outside that rectangle, then return to the tight framing. Must be deterministic in export, smooth at 60/120/240 fps, and work in the live floating preview.
end_state: Selecting Area + Record produces a video framed on the chosen region; typing in the address bar or clicking a tab widens the frame to include it and returns afterwards. Studio replay and export are frame-identical; the live floating preview is causal (no lead-in) and converges to the same crop after the reveal settles. The crop is derived from recorded signals, editable and headlessly testable.
non_goals: Semantic understanding of page content or AI scene classification
Changing ScreenCaptureKit sourceRect during a running stream
Replacing the existing auto-zoom/director camera for non-Area recordings
Visual/UI redesign of the floating bar beyond one toggle and its configuration rows
Capturing a smaller raw file for privacy; raw footage remains the full display

environment.notes: Modules: LumenCapture, LumenProject, LumenCore, LumenDirector, LumenRender, LumenExport, LumenUI, LumenCLI. CameraTrack is 480 Hz; gridRate 1440 Hz. DerivedTracks are in-memory only and rebuilt by Director.derive; Timeline.derived is excluded from CodingKeys. Existing precedent: FrameCropper bakes a time-varying top crop at capture for window mode.

components.name: Full-display capture with persisted ROI
components.description: Area recordings capture the whole display at full resolution. The chosen rectangle moves from sc.sourceRect into a persisted SmartCropConfig on the Timeline.

components.name: Intent signals for chrome reveals
components.description: Clicks and typing bursts whose resolved rect lies outside the content ROI are the uncrop triggers. AXFrame carries rect, caret and label but no structured role, so chrome is defined geometrically as outside the ROI rather than by AX classification.

components.name: Deterministic crop planner
components.description: Builds a time-varying crop track from intents with matched lead-in, hold and return, using the same quintic primitive as the camera solver.

components.name: Per-frame crop in evaluation and compositor
components.description: FrameState carries a source-pixel crop rect; renderer, shader, overlay geometry and upscaler sample within it; camera zoom remains layered on top.

components.name: Causal live preview crop
components.description: LiveCamera produces a live crop rect from events already seen so the floating preview shows the intelligent crop during recording.

components.name: Floating bar configuration
components.description: An intelligent-crop toggle in the Area panel plus reveal-margin and return-duration settings, all stored in Timeline.smartCrop.

components.name: Headless accuracy and cost verification
components.description: Seeded fuzz, sweeps, arrival/stillness checks, determinism, degenerate inputs and performance budgets for the new crop track.

components.name: Documentation and feature matrix
components.description: Update feature.md and the relevant Docs entries so they describe dynamic Area crop rather than static sourceRect.

open_questions: Privacy: raw screen.mov will now contain the full display for Area recordings. Confirm this is acceptable, or require a 'bake crop into raw' option before shipping.
Does a saved Area preset captured on one display need to be re-validated when the user records on a different display configuration?
Should the reveal also trigger on scrolling in the address bar, or only click/typing intents?

tasks.title: Build the deterministic crop director and crop track
tasks.description: Derive a time-varying CropTrack from recorded intents in OUTPUT seconds. An intent outside the ROI expands the crop to include it plus margin; after it ends the crop returns to the ROI. Motion uses QuinticMove. The 0.18 s lead-in and returnSeconds are output seconds; source-time intents are converted with tm.output(atSource:).

files.what: Add `CropTrack` (rate, keyframes in OUTPUT seconds) and a `crop` field on DerivedTracks.
Define public `SmartCropIntent { var t, tEnd: Double /* source s */; var rect: CGRect /* source px */ }` and the planner `plan(config:source:tm:intents:) -> CropTrack` converting to output time.
Sample DerivedTracks.crop into FrameState.cropRect, solve the crop stage in deriveCancellable keyed by a new DeriveCache.CropKey. The cropRect FIELD is declared by T3.1.
Planner unit tests.

subtasks.description: Define `SmartCropIntent { var t, tEnd: Double; var rect: CGRect }` (source seconds, source pixels) and `CropKeyframe { var t: Double /* OUTPUT s */; var rect: CGRect }` with `CropTrack.evaluate(at outputTime:) -> CGRect` using QuinticMove per channel.

Promote Planner.resolvedField from private to internal and call it plus the existing internal usableAX/smallestField from SmartCropPlanner; build intents from clicks (resolved frame rect, source px) and `events.typingBursts()` (resolved field rect, source px). Never use the caret point as the reveal rect.
Define outside-ROI as `intent.rect.intersection(roiPx).isEmpty` in source px. If roi is nil/empty, disable smart crop and emit a full-source constant track.

Convert every intent time with `tm.output(atSource:)` before baking. Expand start = intent.tOut - 0.18, expanded at intent.tOut, return complete at intent.tEndOut + returnSeconds (all output seconds). Expanded rect = union of roiPx and intent.rect grown by revealMarginPt, clipped to source.
Merge overlapping reveal windows so one target exists at a time and no rect leaves source bounds.

Add `struct CropKey: Equatable { config, digest, signature, source }` plus `var cropKey: CropKey?` and `var crop: CropTrack?` to DeriveCache; key the new stage on it. Leave PlanKey (zoom planner) unchanged.
Note in code that the stop-time seed Director.planRecordingZoom does not produce a crop: the live path covers recording and the editor re-derives the crop from full evidence.
Add SmartCropPlannerTests for one reveal, two overlapping reveals, a trigger at trimEnd, a trim + 2x speed ramp, and no intents.

tests.description: A single outside-ROI typing intent expands then returns to exactly the ROI in output time
A reveal still lands on the intended output frame with a trim and a 2x speed ramp

A changed ROI alters CropKey while PlanKey is unchanged

acceptance_criteria: The crop track is pure and deterministic and sampled only in output time
